claims.text: Những người bị xích chân và cổ từ nhỏ, chỉ nhìn được vào vách hang (514a–515c)

sources.quote: Conceive them as having their legs and necks fettered from childhood

claims.text: Sau lưng họ có ngọn lửa; giữa lửa và họ có người mang qua lại những tượng người, tượng thú bằng gỗ, bằng đá

sources.quote: and shapes of animals as well, wrought in stone and wood and every material

claims.text: Quote 515a (Jowett): họ chỉ thấy bóng của chính mình, hay bóng của nhau; bản dịch Logos

sources.quote: Like ourselves, I replied; and they see only their own shadows, or the shadows of one another, which the fire throws on the opposite wall of the cave?
except the shadows cast from the fire on the wall of the cave that fronted them?

claims.text: Quote 515c (Jowett): với họ sự thật chẳng gì khác ngoài bóng của những hình nộm; bản dịch Logos

sources.quote: To them, I said, the truth would be literally nothing but the shadows of the images.
such prisoners would deem reality to be nothing else than the shadows of the artificial objects

claims.text: Họ đặt tên cho các bóng (515b)

sources.quote: they would suppose that in naming the things that they saw they were naming the passing objects

claims.text: trao vinh dự cho kẻ nhanh mắt nhất... bóng nào đến trước, bóng nào đến sau (516c–d)

sources.quote: prizes for the man who is quickest to make out the shadows as they pass and best able to remember their customary precedences

claims.text: Một tù nhân được cởi trói và bị buộc quay lại nhìn lửa: chói mắt, đau đớn, muốn quay về với bóng (515c–e)

sources.quote: felt pain and, because of the dazzle and glitter of the light, was unable to discern the objects
would not that pain his eyes, and would he not turn away and flee to those things which he is able to discern

claims.text: anh bị lôi lên một con dốc gồ ghề, ra ngoài ánh sáng (515e)

sources.quote: drag him thence by force up the ascent which is rough and steep

claims.text: Anh phải tập nhìn từng bậc: bóng, rồi ảnh phản chiếu dưới nước, rồi chính sự vật, rồi trăng sao ban đêm (516a–b)

sources.quote: of the stars and the moon, than by day the sun and the sun's light

claims.text: Quote 516b (Jowett): Sau cùng, anh nhìn được mặt trời...; bản dịch

sources.quote: Last of all he will be able to see the sun, and not mere reflections of him in the water, but he will see him in his own proper place, and not in another; and he will contemplate him as he is.
he would be able to look upon the sun itself and see its true nature, not by reflections in water

claims.text: Nhớ lại bạn tù, người đã ra ngoài thấy thương họ (516c)

sources.quote: do you not think that he would count himself happy in the change and pity them

claims.text: Anh quay xuống hang, mắt chưa quen bóng tối, đoán bóng thua cả những người chưa từng rời chỗ (516e–517a)

sources.quote: in 'evaluating' these shadows while his vision was still dim and before his eyes were accustomed to the dark

claims.text: Quote 517a (Jowett): Men would say of him that up he went and down he came without his eyes...; bản dịch

sources.quote: Men would say of him that up he went and down he came without his eyes; and that it was better not even to think of ascending; and if any one tried to loose another and lead him up to the light, let them only catch the offender, and they would put him to death.
if it were possible to lay hands on and to kill the man who tried to release them and lead them up, would they not kill him?

claims.text: nhà tù là thế giới của thị giác, ánh lửa là mặt trời, cuộc đi lên là hành trình của linh hồn vào thế giới trí tuệ (517b)

sources.quote: likening the region revealed through sight to the habitation of the prison, and the light of the fire in it to the power of the sun

claims.text: Quote 518b–c (Jowett): professors of education must be wrong...; bản dịch

sources.quote: But then, if I am right, certain professors of education must be wrong when they say that they can put a knowledge into the soul which was not there before, like sight into blind eyes.
What they aver is that they can put true knowledge into a soul that does not possess it, as if they were inserting vision into blind eyes

claims.text: Quote 520c (Jowett): each of you, when his turn comes, must go down...; bản dịch

sources.quote: Wherefore each of you, when his turn comes, must go down
Down you must go then, each in his turn, to the habitation of the others and accustom yourselves to the observation of the obscure things there

claims.text: Giáo dục... xoay cả linh hồn về đúng hướng: năng lực nhìn đã có sẵn, chỉ đang nhìn sai chỗ (518c–d)

sources.quote: this organ of knowledge must be turned around from the world of becoming together with the entire soul
on the assumption that it possesses vision but does not rightly direct it and does not look where it should

claims.text: người đã thấy ánh sáng thì không được ở lại trên ấy: họ phải xuống cai trị, và thành phố tốt nhất là nơi người cầm quyền ít muốn cầm quyền nhất (520d)

sources.quote: That they should linger there,” I said, “and refuse to go down again among those bondsmen
the city in which those who are to rule are least eager to hold office must needs be best administered
